mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.discount_type, c.`specific`, c.discount_value, c.threshold_amount, c.max_discount_amount, uc.id AS creater FROM user_coupon uc INNER JOIN coupon c ON uc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 1 AND uc.term_begin_time <= NOW() AND uc.term_end_time >= NOW()
